result.stdout:
Usage: [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Convert text to high-quality MP3 speech using the xAI TTS API.

Options:
  -t, --text <string?>       Text to synthesize. Reads from stdin when omitted. No length limit (uses WebSocket streaming). [Default: null]
  -f, --file <string?>       Path to a UTF-8 text file to read as input (alternative to -t or stdin). [Default: null]
  -o, --output <string>      Output .mp3 file path (directories created if needed). [Default: @"speech.mp3"]
  -v, --voice <string>       Voice ID: rex (default), eve, ara, sal, leo, or a custom voice ID. [Default: @"rex"]
  -l, --language <string>    BCP-47 code (e.g. en, fr, zh, pt-BR) or "auto". [Default: @"en"]
